title: The Academy of Sciences and Its Research Institutes, 2018–2023
grammar: Recap: attributing a judgement with szerint
goal: I can describe how the research institutes of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences were reorganised in 2018–2023, with dates (*kutatóhálózat, autonómia, finanszírozás*).
I can name the source of each view with *szerint* (*a kormány indoklása szerint*).

sections.title: Unit 34: Higher Education and Research, 2010–2026
body: Between 2017 and 2026 the research institutes of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences and many state universities were reorganised, and Central European University moved its US-accredited programmes to Vienna after a change in the higher education law. Each step was defended by the government and criticised by others, in Hungary and abroad.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: attribution, conditions, proportion, cause and result, and contrast. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
